correctness.rationale: For Cr_n=K_{n,n} minus a perfect matching and selected-index sets I,J, an outside a_i sees |J|-1_{i in J} neighbors and outside b_i sees |I|-1_{i in I}. Equality and positivity of all outside degrees gives exactly I=[n] or J=[n], I=J≠empty, or I union J=[n] and |I|=|J|. Partitioning these disjoint cases gives 2x^n(1+x)^n-x^(2n)+sum_{m=1}^{n-1} binom(n,m)x^(2m)+sum_{m=ceil(n/2)}^{n-1} binom(n,m)binom(m,n-m)x^(2m). Thus fd=2 with n minimum sets, and D_f(1)=3*2^n+T_n-4. Independent literal adjacency exhaustive test 87360 subsets for n=3..8 corroborates coefficients; all n follows from the occupancy proof.
